reference.help: Pick the canonical sensor for each environment metric. The agent will quote these as the primary reading and treat all other sensors as cross-checks.
reference.zoneRolesHelp: Tag which zones represent the irrigation feed water and which the drain return. Without this, the agent falls back to matching zone names containing "irrigation" / "drain".

discussion.title: Clarifications & discussion
discussion.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the report now with this clarification? This will call Claude and replace the current report if the new one passes its checks. If regeneration fails, the current report is kept.
discussion.help: Add context the agent doesn't know about — broken sensors, recent maintenance, "ignore today's pH because the probe is uncalibrated", etc. Notes are stored permanently and injected into the prompt on regeneration, so the new report (and any future weekly rollup) reflects your correction.
discussion.placeholder: Add context, correct an assumption, or flag a sensor issue. Example: 'The AMIC pH probe is uncalibrated — ignore pH readings until further notice.'

capture.title: Canopy captures
capture.help: Noon session: {{frames}} {{spacing}} s apart, scored for sharpness. The report gets {{sharpest}}; without a noon session it falls back to the 10:00–14:00 4-hourly snapshots.

sources.intro: What the AI is allowed to look at. Take a system out of service when it is broken and cannot be fixed yet.
sources.appliesTo: Applies to the daily agronomist report and the nightly planner. An out-of-service system is removed from the data the AI sees and it is told not to reason about it, ask for samples, or create tasks for it.
sources.viewOnly: View only — ask an operator or admin to change this.

sources.toastSavedSomeOut_other: Data sources saved — {{count}} out of service
sources.toastSavedAllIn: Data sources saved — everything in use
sources.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Down for the foreseeable future
sources.backOnPassed: The back-on date has passed — this source is treated as in use again.
sources.clickToTakeOut: Click to take out of service
sources.clickToPutBack: Click to put back in use
sources.excludedHelp: Drop a single device from everything the AI sees (readings, reference sensors, diagnostics, alerts, the planner's inventory) without taking its whole system out of service.
sources.unsaved: Unsaved changes — the next AI run still uses the saved settings.

canopyViews.help: Noon: one view from each camera preset ({{names}}), each checked for sharpness and light; the camera goes back to where it was afterwards. Every view goes to the report, labelled. Without a noon session the report falls back to the 10:00–14:00 4-hourly snapshots.
canopyViews.justTaken: Manual tour just taken — {{captured}} of {{total}} views
canopyViews.notRestored: The camera was not put back after this tour — check the live view.
canopyViews.incomplete: {{captured}} of {{total}} views captured; the missing ones are marked.

status.missing: No preset with this name on the camera. Save the preset on the camera, or fix the name in the settings below.
status.goto_failed: The camera did not move to this preset.
status.capture_failed: The camera moved, but no image could be taken.
status.auth_stopped: The camera rejected the login, so the tour stopped at once to avoid a camera lockout. Check the camera password.
status.not_attempted: Not attempted: the camera’s preset list could not be read.
status.missing_file: The image file is no longer stored.

settings.title: Agronomist views
settings.help: Camera presets visited at noon, by name — one image each goes to the report (up to 3). Leave all empty to fall back to a single-preset burst. The camera returns to where it was, or to the preset named under “Return to”.
settings.noneConfigured: No preset named: the noon capture will use the single-preset burst.
settings.checkFailed: Could not read the camera’s presets: {{error}}
